metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Range ~[0,1]. Estimated by mean pairwise cosine similarity of sampled item embeddings (mapped to [0,1]). Higher indicates stronger directional alignment; 0.5 corresponds to zero mean cosine. This does not measure recommendation diversity or simulator traits. Null means fewer than two sampled items.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Category breakdown is unavailable because item categories are not provided. Only total low-margin and wrong-rank counts over valid training positions are measured. Null margin statistics mean no valid comparisons.
metric_definitions.recent_dependence: Fixed training-history, fixed-positive/negative candidate encoder-logit dependence measurements; these are not validation HR or causal effects. Norms average over nonpadding positions. Alpha is an unconstrained scalar. Branch removal scores backbone features with identical candidates. Recent removal masks the last five positions; distant removal masks the preceding five. Perturbation RMS uses only users whose nonpadding history changed. The unchanged-history maximum difference is a numerical control. Null values denote unavailable measurements. Graph score contributions, if present outside predict_score, are not measured by these encoder probes.
